title: Universal KB Relation Types — v2
description: Canonical relation types for a universal second brain. Each entry defines a predicate with allowed subject_types and object_types (any of the 5 entity types unless constrained). Wrappers reject any relation whose (subject_type, predicate, object_type) tuple is not permitted here.

relations.description: General reference from any entity to any entity.
A Procedure or Concept addresses a Finding or Concept.
A Finding or Pattern was observed in this Session.
A Finding is resolved by following this Procedure.
A Finding or Concept is an instance of this Pattern.
Generic relationship between any two entities.
Something was corrected in this Session.
A newer entity supersedes an older one (older marked deprecated).
A Finding, Procedure, or Pattern is disputed by a Session or Concept; awaiting resolution.
Subject directly causes or produces the object. Use for causal chains (event → outcome, finding → symptom, action → consequence).
Subject requires or depends on the object to function or proceed. Use for dependencies, prerequisites, sequential ordering.
Subject is an alternative option to the object. Use for competing approaches, options, solutions, or candidates.
